name: systemic-fix-beta
description: Self-calibrating discipline for bug fixes: treat the local fault as one instance of a class — check scope for the same pattern elsewhere, name the class of mistake, propose prevention drawn from the repo's own lint/pre-commit/test tooling — and report before patching, defaulting to a local fix. First run calibrates a per-repo profile (module map, bug-label taxonomy, discipline-hook inventory). Beta — the `-beta` suffix is intentional; graduates to `systemic-fix` when it earns its stable slot.
